description: RBAC role definitions for affilite-mix. Source of truth for CC1.3/CC1.5/CC6.1 SOC 2 controls. Roles are stored in the `roles` table (Supabase) and enforced by lib/dal/permissions.ts + lib/authz.ts.

roles.name: owner
roles.label: Owner
roles.description: Full platform control including billing, site creation, and user management. Cannot be assigned — only the platform bootstrap process creates owners.

roles.name: super_admin
roles.label: Super Admin
roles.description: Full administrative access across all sites. Can manage users, settings, and all content. Device-bound sessions use /32 IP binding (stricter than /24 for other roles).

roles.name: admin
roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Site-scoped administrative access. Can manage content, products, categories, settings, and integrations within assigned sites. Requires admin_site_memberships row.

roles.name: editor
roles.label: Editor
roles.description: Can create, edit, and publish content and products. Cannot manage users, settings, or integrations.

roles.name: author
roles.label: Author
roles.description: Can create and edit own content. Cannot publish or manage products.

roles.name: moderator
roles.label: Moderator
roles.description: Can approve/reject user-generated content (comments, wrist shots). Cannot create or edit site content.

roles.name: seo_manager
roles.label: SEO Manager
roles.description: Can manage SEO metadata, canonical URLs, and sitemap settings. Cannot modify content body.

roles.name: translator
roles.label: Translator
roles.description: Can view and edit content for translation purposes. Cannot publish or manage structure.

roles.name: analyst
roles.label: Analyst
roles.description: Read-only access to analytics, content, and products. Cannot modify any data.

enforcement.middleware: lib/authz.ts — withAuthz() wrapper checks hasPermission() before handler execution
enforcement.dal: lib/dal/permissions.ts — getPermissionsForRole() + hasPermission() with per-request caching
enforcement.admin_guard: lib/admin-guard.ts — requireAdmin() enforces membership + role assertion
enforcement.session_binding: lib/auth.ts — device-bound JWT with IP/24 (admin) or IP/32 (super_admin) binding

separation_of_duties.description: Critical operations require different roles to prevent single-actor abuse
rules: User creation requires super_admin; user cannot self-elevate
Publishing requires editor or above; authors cannot self-publish
Settings changes require admin; editors cannot modify site config
Privacy/DSAR operations require admin with privacy:view permission
